info.name: GitHub Copilot REST Copilot Billing Copilot Seats API
Github Copilot List All Copilot Seat Assignments for an Organization

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of results to fetch.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100).

items.docs: Enumerates all active Copilot seats for which an organization is currently billed, including user activity metrics such as last activity date, editor, and authentication timestamp.

info.name: Github Copilot Get Copilot Seat Assignment Details for a User

params.name: username
params.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

items.docs: Retrieves comprehensive seat assignment information for a specific organization member, including usage patterns, last activity, and assignment origin.
